provenance: Generated for EDWARD IV using OpenAI ImageGen, 17 October 2026. Modern imagined manuscript illustrations, not surviving historical portraits. Converted and resized to WebP for the browser; atlas cells cropped at display time without stretching.

assets.description: Nine fictional officers and ordinary servants, arranged in a 3 by 3 atlas.
Imagined Richard and George as children, displayed before their adult portraits.
Everyday service and supper in an imagined royal household.
Representative Low Countries quay and ship provisioning, not a documented royal itinerary.
Interpretation of confusion in battle mist, not a reconstruction of individual combatants.
